original_excerpt:
From Commissioner v. Kowalski, 434 U.S. 77, 84, 90 (1977):
"The payments are not subject to exclusion from gross income under § 119, since § 119, by its terms, covers meals furnished by the employer and not cash reimbursements for meals... 'Section 119 applies only to meals or lodging furnished in kind.' S. Rep. No. 1622, 83d Cong., 2d Sess., 190 (1954). See also Treas. Reg. § 1.119-1 (c) (2), 26 CFR § 1.119-1 (1977)."
attribution: Reporter syllabus blended with majority quoting Senate report
fidelity: Opening 'The payments are not subject ... since ...' is syllabus wording on 77–78, not literal majority wording at 84. In-kind Senate-report quotation and regulation citation appear in majority at 84, not 90 as suggested by combined pinpoint.
scope_note: Core §119 proposition supported. Separate syllabus attribution, majority text, and nested Senate-report quotation; do not imply independently verified Rev. Rul. 71-131 text.
